What do you do to stay healthy?
exercise. Activity that moves your body and keeps you fit.
weight. How heavy a person or thing is.
headache. A pain inside your head.
medical. About doctors and keeping your body healthy.
dentist. A doctor who takes care of your teeth.
allergy. When your body reacts badly to food, dust or pollen.
supplement. A pill you take to add something good to your diet.
donate. To give something to help people.
pollution. Dirty air, water or land that can hurt living things.
Countable nouns can be counted. Uncountable nouns cannot be counted.
